title: MOSS-Image SFT
description: Local MOSS-Image SFT text-to-image generation adapted from the official Comfy-Org workflow. The selectable test path sends the user's prompt directly and keeps the official 25-step, CFG 2.5, er_sde/simple defaults; the current local worker does not yet have the required MOSS support or model files, so live output quality and speed are not qualified.

evidence: Adapted official Comfy-Org workflow_templates at 86ce86e92ec77e3c3c6d4a754e69cfce37886542; source SHA-256 91d76c158a1e427c09904c6222978065c1ed965c8b3f40ae323e649808af2198.

Retains the official SFT INT8 model, Qwen 3.5 W4A8 encoder, small Flux 2 VAE, 25-step, CFG 2.5, er_sde/simple defaults. The optional prompt upsampler and skip-layer branches are disabled for a direct, bounded first test.

Packaged direct-prompt API graph SHA-256: 38ff285e28a2e5832c7402cb3ed461c86da78392575ff04b7ef85db19394398a. Catalogue, schema, graph-policy and readiness integration are tested. The current local worker lacks the moss_image CLIP type and all three model files; no model loading, generation, speed, memory or image-quality qualification has been performed.
